answer_1.quote: We conducted end-to-end question answering (QA) experiments to analyze the impact of retrieval accuracy on downstream QA performance. The retrieved results were directly input into a multimodal LLM generator for answer generation, primarily using the Qwen2.5-VL 7B model.
